skills.name: Handstand push-up
skills.goal: Freestanding handstand push-up on parallettes, 5 reps
skills.why: The bodyweight version of your shoulder press, built on the handstand. Smith's Handstand Toolkit runs the balance side.

rungs.name: Pike push-up
cues: Hips high, legs straight, weight forward into the hands
Head travels in front of the hands, elbows tucked at about 45 degrees
Push up and out through the shoulder blades at the top

drills.name: Wall plank (feet on the wall, body flat)

rungs.scene: a pike push-up at the top: hands on the floor, arms straight, hips raised high into an upside-down V, legs straight, feet on the floor, head between the arms looking back at his feet

rungs.name: Chest-to-wall handstand
cues: Walk the feet up the wall and the hands in close, 10-20 cm from the wall
Ribs in, bum squeezed, push tall through the shoulders
Ears covered by the arms

drills.name: Elevated pike push-up (feet on a box)

rungs.scene: a chest-to-wall handstand: upside down, hands on the floor about 15 cm from the wall, arms straight and by his ears, body in a straight vertical line with his chest and toes lightly touching the wall, facing the wall

rungs.name: Toe pulls and partial wall HSPU
cues: Pull the toes off the wall with the fingers, not by bending
Find the balance point, then touch back down softly
HSPU: lower under control, only as far as you can press back
rungs.scene: a handstand facing the wall with only his toes lightly touching it as he pulls them away, body almost vertical and balanced over his straight arms

rungs.name: Freestanding handstand
cues: Kick up softly, catch the balance with the fingers
Straight line wrists, shoulders, hips, ankles
Smith's Toolkit sets your handstand practice

drills.name: Wall HSPU, full range (back to the wall)

rungs.scene: a freestanding handstand in the middle of the room: perfectly straight vertical line, arms locked by his ears, legs together, toes pointed, nothing touching but his hands

rungs.name: Solid handstand and deficit HSPU
cues: Head goes below the hands between the parallettes
Elbows track forward, not flared
Full lockout at the top
rungs.scene: the bottom of a deficit handstand push-up against a wall: hands gripping two parallettes, elbows bent, head lowered down between the bars below hand level, back and heels against the wall, body vertical

rungs.name: Goal: freestanding HSPU on parallettes
cues: Smith's milestone on the way: 3 freestanding HSPU
Stay stacked, lower slowly, press straight up
rungs.scene: a freestanding handstand push-up halfway down on two parallettes: elbows bent about 90 degrees, body a straight vertical line, legs together pointing up, no wall

skills.name: L-sit to press handstand
skills.goal: L-sit, press up to a handstand, hold 10 s
skills.why: Compression, straight-arm strength and the handstand in one move. Your pancake and pike work feed straight into it.

rungs.name: Tuck sit
cues: Push the floor away, shoulders down from the ears
Knees to chest, bum off the floor
Arms locked
rungs.scene: a tuck sit on parallettes, facing left: arms straight pushing down, body lifted so his bottom is off the floor at hand height, knees pulled up to his chest, feet off the floor

rungs.name: One-leg L-sit
cues: Straight leg locked, toes pointed, at hip height
Other knee tucked
Swap legs every set
rungs.scene: a one-leg L-sit on parallettes: arms straight, body lifted, one leg straight out in front at hip height, the other knee tucked to the chest

rungs.name: L-sit
cues: Both legs straight and together, level with the hips
Push down hard, chest proud
Point the toes

drills.name: Compression lifts (seated, hands by the knees)

rungs.scene: a full L-sit on parallettes: arms straight, body upright, both legs straight together held horizontal in front at hip height, toes pointed

rungs.name: High straddle L

pass.name: High straddle L, legs above horizontal

cues: Legs wide and straight, lifted above the hips
Lean the shoulders back a little
Your pancake range sets how high
rungs.scene: a high straddle L-sit on parallettes: arms straight, torso leaning back slightly, legs straight and spread wide in a straddle, lifted above horizontal (feet higher than the hips)

rungs.name: Press from a box

pass.name: Press to handstand from a box

cues: Shoulders lean forward over the hands, hips rise over the shoulders
Tuck first, then straddle as it gets easier
Smith's press lessons cover this

drills.name: Press from a box (tuck, then straddle)

rungs.scene: halfway through a tuck press to handstand: hands on the floor, arms straight, shoulders leaning forward over the hands, hips lifted up above the shoulders, knees tucked, feet just lifted off a low box behind him

rungs.name: Goal: L-sit to press handstand
cues: L-sit, lean, lift the hips, straddle up, close the legs
Smith's milestone on the way: 5 straddle presses
rungs.scene: the middle of a straddle press to handstand on parallettes: arms straight, shoulders leaning forward over the hands, hips stacked high above the shoulders, legs straight and wide in a straddle, almost horizontal

skills.name: Planche
skills.why: The hardest straight-arm push hold. A multi-year goal: the straddle planche is a big win on its own.

rungs.name: Planche lean

pass.name: Planche lean, shoulders well past the hands

cues: Hands turned slightly out, arms locked
Shoulders travel forward past the hands
Protract: round the upper back a little, body tight
rungs.scene: a planche lean: straight-arm push-up plank on the floor, body straight, shoulders leaning far forward so they are well in front of his hands, up on his toes

rungs.name: Frog stand to crow
cues: Knees on the back of the upper arms, elbows bent
Lean forward until the feet float
Look a little in front of the hands
rungs.scene: a crow stand: squatting forward onto his hands on the floor, elbows bent, knees resting on the backs of his upper arms, feet lifted off the floor, balanced on his hands

rungs.name: Tuck planche
cues: Arms locked, shoulders in front of the hands
Round the upper back, hips at shoulder height
Knees tight to the chest
rungs.scene: a tuck planche on parallettes: balanced only on straight arms, torso horizontal, upper back rounded, knees tucked under the chest, feet off the floor

rungs.name: Advanced tuck planche
cues: Back flat, hips pushed back level with the shoulders
Knees bent about 90 degrees, thighs away from the chest
Lean more to balance
rungs.scene: an advanced tuck planche on parallettes: balanced on straight arms, back flat and horizontal, hips level with the shoulders, thighs pointing down and back, knees bent about 90 degrees, shins horizontal behind him, feet off the floor

rungs.name: Straddle planche
cues: Legs straight and wide, body horizontal
Squeeze the glutes, point the toes
Wider straddle = easier
rungs.scene: a straddle planche on parallettes: body held horizontal above the floor on straight arms, shoulders in front of the hands, legs straight and spread wide apart, toes pointed

rungs.name: Goal: full planche
cues: Legs together, body one straight horizontal line
This is years of work: celebrate each rung
rungs.scene: a full planche on parallettes: whole body held perfectly straight and horizontal above the floor on straight arms, legs together, toes pointed

skills.name: Front lever
skills.why: The classic straight-arm pull. Builds the lats and upper back that balance all the pushing.
skills.equipment: Pull-up bar (garden bar, or the gym until then)

rungs.name: Active hang and pull-ups
cues: Shoulders pulled down away from the ears
Ribs in, legs together
Pull-ups: chest to the bar, full hang at the bottom
rungs.scene: an active hang from a pull-up bar: arms straight overhead, shoulders pulled down and engaged, body straight, legs together, feet clear of the floor

rungs.name: Tuck front lever
cues: Arms straight, pull the bar down towards the hips
Back horizontal, knees to chest
Hips level with the shoulders
rungs.scene: a tuck front lever hanging from a pull-up bar: arms straight, body held horizontal face-up below the bar, back flat, knees tucked tight to the chest

rungs.name: Advanced tuck front lever
cues: Flat back, hips pushed out level
Knees bent about 90 degrees
Squeeze the bar down
rungs.scene: an advanced tuck front lever on a pull-up bar: arms straight, back flat and horizontal face-up, hips level, thighs angled up, knees bent about 90 degrees

rungs.name: One-leg front lever
cues: One leg straight in line with the body, the other tucked
Swap legs every set
rungs.scene: a one-leg front lever on a pull-up bar: arms straight, body horizontal face-up, one leg straight out in line with the body, the other knee bent

rungs.name: Straddle front lever
cues: Both legs straight and wide
Body one horizontal line
Glutes and lats on
rungs.scene: a straddle front lever on a pull-up bar: arms straight, whole body horizontal face-up below the bar, legs straight and spread wide

rungs.name: Goal: full front lever
cues: Legs together, body straight and horizontal
Shoulders, hips and ankles in one line
rungs.scene: a full front lever on a pull-up bar: arms straight, whole body held perfectly straight and horizontal face-up below the bar, legs together

skills.name: Muscle-up
skills.why: Pull and push in one move: from hanging below the bar to pressing out above it.

rungs.name: Pull-ups and false grip
cues: Full hang to chin over the bar
False grip: wrist over the bar, heel of the hand on top
rungs.scene: the top of a strict pull-up: chin above the bar, elbows bent and pulled down, body straight, legs together

rungs.name: Chest-to-bar pull-ups
cues: Pull the bar to the lower chest
Lean back slightly at the top, elbows drive down and back
rungs.scene: the top of a chest-to-bar pull-up: his chest touching the bar, head above it, elbows pulled down and back, body leaning back slightly

rungs.name: Straight-bar dips
cues: Support above the bar, lean the chest forward
Lower until the bar is at the chest, press back to locked arms
rungs.scene: the bottom of a straight-bar dip: he is above a single straight bar with his hands on it, elbows bent and pointing back, chest leaning forward over the bar, legs hanging below

rungs.name: Muscle-up negatives
cues: Start in support above the bar
Lower through the transition as slowly as you can
Band-assisted reps also count as practice
rungs.scene: the transition of a bar muscle-up: chest coming over the bar, hands rotating on top of the bar, elbows high and bent, shoulders above the bar

rungs.name: Goal: strict bar muscle-up
cues: No kip: pull high, lean over, press out
Finish in a locked support above the bar
rungs.scene: the finish of a bar muscle-up: supported above the bar on straight locked arms, the bar at his hips, body upright, legs straight below

warmups.name: Wrist prep
warmups.note: 5 minutes, every session and on rest days. Start with a little weight in the hands and build to full bodyweight (Smith). Log wrist pain 0-10.

extra.name: Calf raises on a step (calf physio)

week_note: Draft for January 2027. Handstand days stay at least 2 days from the shoulder flexibility session (Sunday evening). Pull work needs the garden bar; until then use rows and the Monday gym visit.

next_tier.name: One-arm pull-up
next_tier.gate: 15-20 strict pull-ups, or a pull-up with about 40% of bodyweight added, plus archer pull-ups

next_tier.name: One-arm handstand
next_tier.gate: Smith's one arm programs, after a solid 60 s handstand

next_tier.name: Ring skills (ring muscle-up, iron cross)
next_tier.gate: Rings once the garden bar is up; ring basics first

next_tier.name: 90 degree push-up
next_tier.gate: Freestanding HSPU and a straddle planche

mobility_goals.name: Pancake
mobility_goals.goal: Chest to the floor at a wide straddle

mobility_goals.name: Shoulder flexion
mobility_goals.goal: 180 degrees active overhead on both arms, upper arms by the ears, ribs not flaring: a straight-line handstand
